newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi becomes 28th state to ban gay marriage.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi becomes 28th state to ban gay marriage.

text.p: Gov. Kirk Fordice Wednesday signed into law a same-sex marriage ban that made Mississippi the 28th state to go on record against the practice.

"For too long in this freedom-loving land, cultural subversives have engaged in trench warfare on traditional American values," the Republican conservative declared during a signing ceremony in his office.
Futher decrying the "perverse relationships" of gay couples, Fordice described his signing of the law as a "significant step to protect the foundation of a healthy society."

The measure Fordice signed had passed the state House and Senate earlier this year amid fears that a court in Hawaii could rule in favour of gay marriages and set a legal precedent to be copied in other states.
Last September, President Clinton signed the U.S. Defence of Marriage Act, which allowed states to refuse to recognise gay marriages licensed outside their borders.

The Rev. Carl Naylor, an openly gay cleric at the Jackson Metropolitan Church of the Rainbow, dismissed Fordice's action as "a political ploy", saying the measure had no bearing on real long-term relationships between by gay men and women.
